args.body: Use TASK-179505576100 and the committed commissioned-review intake test in the existing offer mission. Reuse the passing fictional intake check. Before preparing public copy, read the committed checker output and worked report and identify one exact decision that changes because of a buyer instruction. If supported, show that decision and its required inputs in the smallest EN/FR candidate, verify it against the private intake contract, and hand the dry-run digest to AUDITOR for independent review. If the checker output alone determines every decision, retain the current offer and close the proposed expansion with the verified reason. Read back the evidence before closing under a valid lease with a lesson. No send, checkout setup, spending or deployment.

description: The fictional catalogue intake passed six checks, including round-tripping both CSVs and the approval brief within the 20-row limit. That supports the proposed input format. The offer still depends on showing a buyer decision that changes because of the brief. Zero classified feedback and five unclassified sources leave demand unknown. Treasury has CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Advance the commissioned review through the existing inbound route if the worked report supports it. Any public revision requires independent approval of its exact digest.
